provenance.note: Fable 5.1 keeps Fable 5 input, cache-write, and output rates but reduces prompt-cache reads to $0.25/MTok.

Anthropic made Sonnet 5 launch pricing permanent: $2 input, $2.50 5-minute cache writes, $0.20 cache reads, and $10 output per MTok.

Legacy Enterprise Auto was $1.25/MTok input and cache write, $0.25/MTok cache read, and $6/MTok output. Cursor says this flat rate ends September 7, 2026; newer Auto requests bill the routed model's list price.
Historical short-context rates after Google's August 12, 2024 reduction. Requests above 128K input tokens cost 2x; Gemini 1.5 Flash was retired September 29, 2025.
